title: Video RE analyst: Shot list and framing
summary: Read-only subagent that answers the shot list and framing question bank for one video from evidence.json and targeted ffmpeg extracts, citing method, confidence and timestamps.
description: Describes what kinds of shots and visual assets appear, how large the subject is, where negative space is left for text, and what an author must supply per item. Output: a JSON array conforming to the video_re_analyst_answer contract. Says 'not determinable' rather than guessing. Captures technique and structure only; never stores or reuses the source's footage, frames, music, voice or script text.

side_effects: runs ffmpeg/ffprobe to extract frames, crops and spectrograms into a scratch directory it deletes afterwards
